rate_type_contract.deaths_per_100000_exposure: calculated_rate = deaths / exposure * 100000; exposure unit must be consistent and explicitly documented
rate_type_contract.q_x: interval death probability; must be supplied by a life table source, not calculated as deaths/exposure
rate_type_contract.m_x: central mortality rate; do not treat as equivalent to q_x

prohibitions: No inferir población, periodo, edad, exposición ni tasa sin fuente
No alimentar H1/H2 hasta validar mapeo y eficacia
